source.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

target_regions.reason: The chart encodes training/test error trajectories for multiple plain and residual networks. Exact/approximate plotted values and curve relationships require the visual region rather than caption text alone.
benchmark_question_plan: Read approximate terminal test-error values for selected curves from the right panel with a human-defined numeric tolerance.
Compare the terminal testing-error ordering of residual-110 and residual-1202 using only the validated chart crop.

target_regions.reason: The page visually encodes parallel VGG/plain/residual architectures and shortcut topology. Some required relations are carried by arrows/solid-vs-dotted connections rather than recoverable from nearby prose alone.
benchmark_question_plan: Identify the output-size transitions at which dotted shortcut connections occur in the 34-layer residual architecture.
Trace the relationship between the plain and residual branches at one validated stage without relying on full-page prose.

annotation_requirements_before_quality_g: authoritative PDF SHA-256 and exact page count
validated PDF-coordinate bbox for each figure region
human-checked question/answer facts grounded only in each crop
linked caption text retained separately from crop-only visual facts
explicit labels for any fact already stated in caption/prose so it is not counted as visual-semantic recovery
quality_scope: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 is the first multimodal candidate on these regions.
Qwen3.5-4B visual use is permitted only if PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 fails, abstains, or cannot meet the visual quality gate.
No general VLM is run on the rest of the document.
authority_and_transport: Original downloaded arXiv PDF is benchmark authority after SHA-256 capture.
Public web text/screenshots are selection evidence only and are not candidate input, benchmark oracle, or production routing evidence.
PDF bytes and rendered crops remain outside Git; Git stores manifest, hashes, region metadata, and compact annotations.
model_gate: No VLM/model download is opened by this manifest alone.
